text:
michael-sales: Synergia POC blocked by CISO. They need a temporary peering + a 20min high-throughput demo for an exec session tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Also asking for a hard demo spend cap and an LOA. Can ops/security advise asap? :exclamation:

tara-eng: We can support a short-lived peering + KV warmup. What's the CIDR and requested throughput?

michael-sales: CIDR 203.0.114.64/27. They want 60 Mbps for 20 minutes. Will accept up to $1,200 for the demo if we provide runbook and LOA.

evan-ops: We can create a TTL peering (3h) with an egress override. Draft ACL below. Need KMS alias and exact reviewer /32s for SSO.

```
peering_id: synergia-demo-01
from_tenant: redwood-demo-tenant
to_cidr: 203.0.114.64/27
allowed_ports: [443]
duration_hours: 3
egress_limit_mbps: 60
acl: ["203.0.114.66/32","203.0.114.67/32"]
logging_kms_alias: "alias/synergia-demo-logs"
teardown_after: 30m_after_window
```

nora-security: Security checklist: TLS-only, logs to customer KMS alias, retention 45d, SSO read-only for their reviewer. I can fast-track if ops posts the runbook link and exact ACL.

tara-eng: Two asks from eng: 1) enable KV cache pre-warm 12min before the demo; 2) set model routing fallback to hosted with instant failover. Evan, can you add health checks and a weighted route?

evan-ops: Will add pre-warm cron and a health-check every 10s. Weighted routing: primary=peered, fallback=hosted-1. Push staged config now. Runbook RB-40111 being created.

deploy-bot: [change-request] synergia-demo-01 requested by evan-ops. Runbook RB-40111 created.

michael-sales: Who can approve the $1,200 capped demo? Liz? Exec wants quick confirmation so procurement can sign LOA.

liz-csm: I can approve the $1.2k cap. Please add PO note to the ticket and I'll notify procurement. Also ask legal if LOA template required.

nora-security: I reviewed staged ACL and runbook link. Condition: logs must be pushed to the customer KMS alias and SSO access granted. Once evan confirms the exact /32s and runbook is live I'll sign off.

evan-ops: Staged config pushed to ticket, KMS alias set to alias/synergia-demo-logs, runbook RB-40111 is live. Deploying staged peering in eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: [deploy] synergia-demo-01 staged in eu-west-1  runbook RB-40111 status: staged -> pending validation.

tara-eng: Quick smoke from restricted host: TLS handshake OK, latency ~100ms with KV warmup. Fallback route configured.

nora-security: Signing off. Conditions met: KMS alias=alias/synergia-demo-logs, retention=45d, SSO read-only access granted. :white_check_mark:

liz-csm: Billing cap approved. PO note added. Sending LOA template to customer now.

evan-ops: Deploying live peering. infra shows live -> monitoring. Scheduling teardown 11:40 UTC (40min after window).

deploy-bot: [deploy] synergia-demo-01 live in eu-west-1. RB-40111 monitoring.

tara-eng: Verified demo route and fallback. KV warmup running 12min pre-run. Latency stable ~105ms. Ready for execs.

michael-sales: Thanks team. Liz, I'll wait for LOA sig then confirm with Synergia. Reminder to teardown after window.

evan-ops: Teardown scheduled at 11:40 UTC. Will post a confirm once removed.

deploy-bot: [reminder] teardown job for synergia-demo-01 scheduled at 11:40 UTC.

evan-ops: Teardown complete. Peering removed, egress overrides reverted, logs archived to alias/synergia-demo-logs. Closing runbook RB-40111.

michael-sales: Great work  Thanks everyone, closing POC ticket and following up with Synergia procurement. :rocket:
